---
title: "No free refills: prior drying and vertebrate colonization alter ecological functioning and vertebrate fitness within experimental aquatic systems"
output: html_notebook
---

```{r}
#Journal of Freshwater Biology
#Manuscript FWB-P-Sep-22-0415
#Amphibian Analyses

#Load packages required for analyses
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(MASS)
library(car)
library(multcomp)
library(ggplot2)
library(lattice)
library(effects)

#Selecting working directory
setwd("C:/Users/krist/Dropbox/WSU Grad Research/1_Ward Mesocosms 2021/Field Data")

#Selecting Excel data sheet
FData <- read_excel("Fish Data.xlsx")

#Allocating each variable as a factor or numeric variable
FData$Treatment <- as.factor(FData$Treatment)
FData$A_Pres <- as.factor(FData$A_Pres)
FData$Drying <- as.factor(FData$Drying)
```


```{r}
#Analyzing the difference in fish growth between amphibian presence and absence treatments via glm and subsequent ANOVA
Fish1<- glm(Rel_SLGrowth ~ A_Pres, data=FData)
Anova(Fish1,type=c("II"))
summary(Fish1)

#Graphing the above ANOVA via ggplot box plot
ggplot(FData, aes(x=A_Pres, y=Rel_SLGrowth)) + geom_boxplot(size=1) + theme_classic() + stat_summary(fun=mean, geom="point", shape=19, size=2)+  ggtitle("Fish Growth Based on Presence of Amphibians")+ ylab("Relative Growth") + xlab("Amphibian Presence") + theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size =10)) + theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 12))

```


```{r}
#Analyzing the difference in fish growth between drying treatments via glm and subsequent ANOVA
Fish2<- glm(Rel_SLGrowth ~ Drying, data=FData)
Anova(Fish2,type=c("II"))
summary(Fish2)

#Graphing the above ANOVA via ggplot box plot
ggplot(FData, aes(x=Drying, y=Rel_SLGrowth)) + geom_boxplot(size=1) + theme_classic() + stat_summary(fun=mean, geom="point", shape=19, size=2)+  ggtitle("Fish Growth Based on Drying")+ ylab("Relative Growth") + xlab("Drying versus Not Drying") + theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size =10)) + theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 12))

```


```{r}
#Analyzing the difference in fish growth in response to an interaction between amphibian presence and drying treatment via glm and subsequent ANOVA
#The "*" symbol represents an interaction effect within the glm
Fish3<- glm(Rel_SLGrowth ~ A_Pres*Drying, data=FData)
Anova(Fish3,type=c("III"))
summary(Fish3)
#Since there was no significant outcome, the ANOVA was not graphed

```
